stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The guide home has sections that say nothing useful ('שני חלקים בכל חיסכון', 'מאיפה להתחיל').","where":"the sections above or below the list of guides","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The page gives no fees, returns or tax amounts, so they can't choose
The guide's intro line doesn't say what to do
The sentence 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה...' is unclear: which line?
'מאיפה להתחיל' is written for working employees, with nothing for someone near retirement
Tax-benefit card doesn't say how big the annual ceiling is or how long the legal waiting period is
Retirement cards are confusing: comprehensive vs general pension, and 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים'
Footer says 'data correct as of' but no data or numbers appear anywhere
'בשפה פשוטה' lines mostly just repeat the product name
'יומית'/'מתחדשת' buttons are confusing: are they fund types, and can you click them?
Too many index cards, and they all look alike (would cut most of them)
Doesn't understand 'חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו'
Doesn't understand 'קרן שעוקבת אחריו'
Doesn't understand 'תקרה למניה אחת'
Doesn't understand who the 'ועדת ההשקעות' is or whether they pay it
Abbreviations אג"ח and מק"מ appear before they are explained
No figures for how much each option could fall in a bad year
Nothing on age-related rules: when you can withdraw, and whether it's tax-free
No information on whether deposits or bonds are insured or guaranteed
No simple starting point based on amount and time horizon
Would drop the 'לילדים' section
Would drop the 'לבחירה עצמית' section

problems.why: The reader praises 'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון' as useful, and only says 'מאיפה להתחיל' is aimed at employees, not that it says nothing useful, so no raised item matches the person's complaint.
